meta.title: Pelago: your Trade Republic portfolio, over time
meta.desc: A free, open-source Windows app that turns your Trade Republic CSV file into a portfolio map with a slider to go back to any day. Everything stays on your PC.
og.sub: Free · open source · everything stays on your PC

lang.label: Language
hero.h1: How has your portfolio changed over time?
hero.lead: The Trade Republic CSV file doesn't tell you. Pelago does: a colored tile map of your portfolio, with a slider to go back to any day in the past.
hero.sub: Free, no ads, free software. Everything stays on your PC.
hero.meta: 64-bit Windows 10/11 · GPL-3.0 · not affiliated with Trade Republic
hero.video.hint: Press play: the portfolio changes over time (example account with invented data, no audio).
hero.video.label: Video without audio: the portfolio map changes as the days go by
hero.video.fallback: Your browser cannot play this video.
features.lead: One CSV file, many ways to read it. The screenshots show an example account with invented data.
card.map.d: One tile per holding: the bigger, the more it is worth; the color tells you whether you are up or down against cost.
card.map.alt: Portfolio map: colored tiles grouped by category
card.time.d: Pick a day in the past, or press “Play” and watch holdings appear, grow and disappear.
card.time.alt: The portfolio map on a day in the past, with the time slider
card.overview.d: Total, categories, deposits, returns and costs of the account, at a glance.
card.overview.alt: Account overview with totals, returns, composition and trend
card.charts.d: What was in the account, month by month, and whether you were above or below your deposits.
card.charts.alt: Chart of the account composition month by month
card.closed.d: How much you made or lost on each holding you sold, net of fees and taxes already withheld.
card.closed.alt: Table of closed positions with the result of each holding
card.tax.d: An informational summary, year by year. These are estimates: they do not replace your broker's documents or a tax adviser.
card.tax.alt: Informational tax summary, with a notice that the values are estimates
card.bonds.d: For Italy, the list of fixed-rate BTPs: pick one and work out how many you can buy, the coupons and the surplus at maturity.
card.bonds.alt: BTP calculator with coupons and surplus at maturity
card.assist.d: Hover a column or a number: Pelago explains what it is and how it is calculated.
card.assist.alt: An Assistant mode tip explaining a table column
card.theme.t: Five languages, light and dark theme
card.theme.d: Italian, English, French, German and Spanish. Your CSV is never modified; a local backup is one click away.
card.theme.alt: The overview in the dark theme
start.1.d: From your Trade Republic account, export the CSV file of your transactions.
start.2.d: Get pelago.exe from the latest version and run it: it is a single file, with no installation.
start.3.d: Press “Open CSV” and choose the file. Your CSV is never modified.
start.req: You need 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the WebView2 Runtime, already included in Windows 11 and in most up-to-date Windows 10 installations.
start.try.h: Want to try it without your own data?
start.try.p: Start Pelago without opening any file and press “Try an example account”: a second window opens with an invented account (about 160 transactions), in a temporary folder that disappears when you close it. If you prefer, download the example CSV and open it with “Open CSV”.
privacy.1: Your CSV and your data stay on your PC. Pelago never asks for a login or a password and never connects to your account.
privacy.2: For prices it queries public services (Yahoo Finance, CoinGecko, ECB, Borsa Italiana and a few others) and sends only security codes and dates: never amounts, quantities or personal data.
privacy.3: Derivative prices (Vontobel and Société Générale) are off by default: you turn them on yourself, from the Quotes page.
privacy.4: The code is public: you can check for yourself that there is nothing else.
privacy.link: Full list of the sites contacted
verify.1: The code is public (GPL-3.0): you can read it, build it yourself and see what it does.
verify.2: Every release lists the SHA-256 fingerprint of pelago.exe. After downloading, in PowerShell:
verify.2b: Compare the result with the pelago.exe.sha256 file of the same release.
verify.3: The executable is not digitally signed: the first time, Windows may show the SmartScreen warning (“Windows protected your PC”). We do not hide it: if you prefer, build Pelago from source.
verify.link: How to build it from source
faq.1.q: Is Pelago official, or connected to Trade Republic?
faq.1.a: No. It is a personal, unofficial project: it is not affiliated with or approved by Trade Republic, and it has no access to your account.
faq.2.a: Nothing. It is free, with no ads and not for profit: free software (GPL-3.0).
faq.3.a: They are estimates calculated from the file: they are not an official balance. Prices come from public services and may be late or missing.
faq.4.q: Can I use it for my tax return?
faq.4.a: Not as your only source. The tax summaries are informational estimates, using simplified formulas: check them against your broker's official documents and with a tax adviser. You are responsible for what you declare.
faq.5.q: Does it work with other brokers, or on Mac and Linux?
faq.5.a: It is designed for the Trade Republic CSV: there is no guarantee with files from other brokers. For now it only runs on 64-bit Windows 10/11.
faq.6.a: Delete pelago.exe: it does not write to the registry and does not start with the computer. To remove the data too, delete the folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pelago and, if you turned them on, the backups in Documents\Pelago backup.
faq.7.q: I found a mistake or have an idea: how do I report it?
faq.7.a: Open an issue on GitHub or write to {{email}}. Never attach your real CSV: it contains all your transactions.
warn.p: Pelago calculates values, returns and tax summaries from the CSV file you give it, using simplified formulas: they are estimates, may contain errors or fail to account for every case (different formats, corporate actions, tax regime, foreign taxes). They are not an official balance, nor financial, legal or tax advice, and they do not replace your broker's official documents or a professional: always check the numbers before using them, in particular for your tax return. Pelago is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind (GPL-3.0, sections 15-16): to the extent permitted by law, the author is not liable for any damage arising from the use of the program or its results.
